languages.name: Solidity
hazard_notes: msg.sender changes across an external call; tx.origin does not.
delegatecall executes foreign code in the caller storage context.
Pre-0.8 arithmetic wraps; 0.8+ reverts unless unchecked.
ERC-777/721/1155 hooks re-enter during transfer.
address.balance can be forced via selfdestruct or beacon roots.
languages.default_visibility_risk: Functions without a visibility specifier do not compile on modern Solidity; state vars default to internal.

languages.name: Vyper
hazard_notes: 0.2.x top-level defs default to public/external.
raw_call revert_on_failure default changed across versions.
@nonreentrant was broken in 0.2.15-0.3.0 (Curve 2023).
0.3.7 had a storage-corruption compiler bug.
send() forwards 2300 gas and returns a bool that must be checked.

languages.name: Huff
hazard_notes: No type system or automatic overflow checks.
Stack height is the programmer's responsibility.
Short calldata can fall through a dispatcher.
languages.default_visibility_risk: All bytecode is reachable if the dispatcher does not revert.

languages.name: Rust / Anchor / Solana
hazard_notes: AccountInfo is unchecked; prefer typed Account/Signer.
CPI program id must be constrained.
PDAs need canonical bump.
Duplicate mutable accounts alias state.
Token vs Token-2022 program identity matters.
Sysvars passed as AccountInfo can be spoofed.
languages.default_visibility_risk: Anchor constraints are opt-in; missing Signer is silent.

languages.name: Move (Aptos / Sui)
hazard_notes: Resources cannot be copied or dropped unless abilities allow it.
Entry functions must validate the signer.
Capabilities are bearer instruments — losing one is losing auth.
languages.default_visibility_risk: public entry is an ABI surface; friend/public need explicit review.

languages.name: Cairo / Starknet
hazard_notes: get_caller_address is the only caller identity.
Upgradeability is a class-hash replacement.
Felt arithmetic wraps at the field prime.

languages.name: Sway / Fuel
hazard_notes: msg_sender() returns Result and must be unwrapped carefully.
Storage writes require #[storage(write)].

languages.name: Tact / TON
hazard_notes: TON is message-oriented; bounced messages must be handled.
sender() is the immediate previous contract, not the original user.
Value must be reserved or the contract can be drained by bounce fees.
languages.default_visibility_risk: receive() and external() are the public ABI.
